notes:
What's new in 0.1.108:
- Web player: seeking back after the "Up next" countdown has started now stops it until the end comes round again.
- Movies and TV Shows: the A-Z letter jumps no longer fire from dropdowns, dialogs, text boxes or when Ctrl, Alt or the Windows key is held.
- Customize layout: dropped files no longer navigate away, Alt+Up/Down in a dropdown opens it instead of moving a row, keyboard moves keep your place, and a failed save keeps your hidden rows and unsaved layout. Layout Share needs a review before applying, refuses files over 64 KB or not plain text, and can no longer hang on a special file (Mac and Linux).
- Users > View stats and the Dashboard now count watch time the same way: calendar days, plays of 60 seconds or more, overlaps once. Display only; no stored history was changed.
- Story Studio: 36 painted art files that were left out of the installer are now included.
- The hardware and connection-cost tables in Settings are translated in German, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese. The Music list recovers after a failed load. The Car Party guest page handles late or out-of-order updates.
- Not fixed: changing video quality while a film plays can still restart the converter. A TV linked through a member sign-in can still get the owner's photo powers, and the wake-up information (a network address) can still be seen by a media-only session. Chromecast items are still being tested. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not in this release.
- Not yet checked: automated tests and code review only; not tried on a real PC yet.
- Release source commit a156aa7a8.
- Built: Oct 28, 2026, 9:32 AM Eastern.
- Published: Jan 1, 2099, 12:00 AM Eastern.
